text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [DNA Digivolve] Yellow Lv.5 + purple Lv.5: Cost 0 Stack the 2 specified Digimon and digivolve unsuspended.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast DNA Digivolve ([Angewomon] + [LadyDevimon])＞ (1 of your specified Digimon and 1 specified card in the hand may DNA digivolve into this card.) [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 5 or lower [Angel], [Archangel] or [Fallen Angel] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, if DNA digivolving, place 1 other Digimon as the bottom security card, and trash the top cards of your opponent's security stack so that it has 4 cards left.

text_sections.label: Special Rule
text_sections.text: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
